# Cncf Sdc Reviewer

Review SDC using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Automation &amp; Configuration category. SDC (schema Driven Configuration) exposes any schema based configuration as Kubernetes resources.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
